competitorNotes: Scorpio results are dominated by gradient aura prints and scorpion/goddess illustrations, mostly $2-10 printables; titles pair 'Scorpio' with 'Zodiac Poster' and 'Scorpio Birthday Gift'.
Competitors use October 23 - November 21, matching this poster; 'intense' recurs as a trait word.
Most single-sign Etsy results are digital downloads; stating 'physical poster print' separates this listing.
Minimalist glyph-only sign prints exist but are mostly A4/A5 printables; the common styles are constellations, gradient 'aura' circles, and illustrations.
An Amazon 16x20 Scorpio print uses Oct 24 - Nov 22, so date ranges differ by seller.
Amazon zodiac titles spell out size plus 'unframed' and the room (bedroom, living room, office); 12-sign sets, canvases, and tin signs crowd the results.

research.notes: Listing pages were not reachable from this environment; evidence is from search results only. 'scorpio zodiac poster' is the sign-plus-product phrase in competitor titles and the query run; sign tags use the glyph, dates, and traits printed on this poster. Birth-month phrasing follows competitors' month-based birthday titles. No priceRange: snippets did not separate physical, unframed prints from framed prints and digital downloads.
